description: Fetches decentralized exchange (DEX) liquidity pools for a token or pair across chains via DexScreener (with GeckoTerminal fallback). Returns chain, DEX name, pair address, base/quote tokens, USD price, liquidity, 24h volume, 24h transaction count, price change percentages, and pool creation age. Limit up to 30 pools. Information only, not financial advice. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

chain.description: Optional chain filter (e.g. ethereum, solana, base)

limit.description: Maximum number of pools to return (max 30)

token.description: Token contract address or symbol to search pools for

name: dex_pools
title: Dex Pools
